pages.text: AppleSkin shows what food does. Food tooltips list hunger and saturation, the hunger bar shows how much a held item would restore, and saturation appears as an overlay. Useful with the larger food list of $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l).

pages.title: Food Values
pages.text: AppleSkin adds hunger and saturation values to food tooltips. Hold food to preview the refill on the bar.
Thirst has its own bar: $(l:survival/thirst)Thirst$(/l). Seasons decide what you can grow: $(l:survival/seasons)Seasons$(/l). Cold Sweat and Smog add their own hazards.
